svg.title: tinyml-bench architecture and benchmark flow
svg.desc: Synthetic vibration windows become 64-dimensional FFT features and train a 64-32-16-8-16-32-64 autoencoder. The model is converted to float32, int8 PTQ and int8 QAT TFLite files. Host latency is measured with the TFLite interpreter; the ESP32 TFLite Micro harness is ready but unmeasured. Both feed one JSON schema, which gen_report.py turns into the README table.
svg.text: synthetic vibration → 64-D FFT features → autoencoder → float32 / int8 PTQ / int8 QAT
trained on normal windows only · θ = μ + 3σ, recomputed per model / precision
